description: Submit a domain that publishes an llms.txt so it gets crawled and indexed. Returns the verification instructions so you can continue without another call. Verified owners get: Manage your listing in the browser; ownership confirmation is optional for discovery; Breakage alerts by webhook, or email when configured, when the llms.txt stops validating; Your terms for agents (automated access, rate limit, attribution, pricing) published where agents read them; Editable profile: description, tags, nested llms.txt files, contact; Measured web, REST and MCP request counts, documentation selections, publisher clicks and score history; no unique-agent claims; Domain ownership confirmation shown separately from content quality or endorsement; Instant re-crawl on demand.
